original_observer_match: TX0 strongest of 2 RX with Hann, 4x zero padding, 30%-peak earliest threshold; independent office parity uses strongest of 4 ports separately
correction: r_corrected=r_raw - (-0.5315983906250129), NEVER use office-internally-estimated LoS median
rf_error_model: Predeclared 2-component, normalized full-source TX0 signed error: Normal(LoS-clear positional data) and Student-t(df=3, blocked positional data), with weights by counts 25/35 and 10/35. No performance parameter fitting on anchor holdouts.

calibration_groups.fit: OFFICE LoS-clear 25 and NLoS-blocked 10 unique positions, RF fit source office only
heldout: A2B 14 positions: geometrically paired with A2, NOT 14 extra independent RF scenes
calibration_groups.scope: independent office-vs-corridor scene transfer; no external actual measurement certification

dr_fault_prior.origin: prior synthetic fixed trial; NOT independently calibrated DR fault prior

rule.guard: if DR>RF and NIS>6.634896601 and p_RF_closer>=0.95, radial estimate=RF corrected by inlier bias; else exactly DR; test post-mean vs guarded action separately
rule.calibration: threshold and action are experimental and NOT independently probability calibrated
rule.outlier_unknown: Observe false-rescues and do not retune based on heldout labels

success_criteria.B: Input parity + measured external holdout likelihood scores; independent calibration claim only if uncertainty/tail coverage and correct sensor port contract hold. Low n blocks 99% guarantee.
success_criteria.C: C2 absolute error improves >0.5m, C1/C3/C4 guarded action does not worsen DR more than 1e-9, no truth used in online inference; if unmet, hypothesis CONTRADICTED and no posterior retuning.

validation_scope: B and C only. Full nonlinear G2/G3, joint pose/Heading and recursive F NOT_RUN. Scientific independent calibration of DR Fault prior NOT ESTABLISHED.
